entries.speaker: Duplication
entries.en: You can now ask Yusuke to use his [clr 1]Duplication[clr 27][n]ability to make you copies of skill cards.

entries.speaker: Duplication
entries.en: To copy a skill card, give Yusuke a blank card and[n]the card you want to copy. Both cards will be[n]available for you to pick up the [clr 2]next day[clr 27].

entries.speaker: Duplication
entries.en: [clr 2]The blank card will be transformed[clr 27] to create the[n]new skill card. Yusuke will return both the new and[n]original cards to you.

entries.speaker: Duplication
entries.en: Blank cards can be obtained from [clr 2]search objects[n]in Mementos[clr 27]. Try to find as many as you can.
